votes.evidence: bc7090d src/rules/auth.ts AUTH_002's missing() returns only a Claude warning when a.prm is set ('a well-known PRM still resolves'), with an explicit comment that the spec needs only one discovery mechanism. AUTH_016 has severity {spec:'error', chatgpt:'warning'}. When the invalid-token 401 lacks resource_metadata it returns {severity:'warning'} with no platforms, so the finding uses both rule platforms (spec+chatgpt) and never looks at snap.authProbe.prm. The same root cause therefore gives two findings that disagree on the spec and ChatGPT verdict. Nothing about this in the round 1 or 3 findings. CHANGELOG mentions AUTH-016 only for DPoP parsing and network-inconclusive handling.
